resources.string: A TV-local helper measures the foreground Android app. No connected computer is needed after helper startup. Not HDMI FPS or display refresh rate.

Enable local app-FPS measurement? The helper automatically follows the foreground app and hides the reading on Home or when the layer cannot be measured. Stop disables sampling. After a reboot, start the helper again from a computer.

One-time standalone setup: review the diagnostic and Usage Access permissions, then run setup-standalone.py --grant from your computer. The grants survive reboot; afterward, Enable works from the TV without a computer or Shizuku. Revoke them using setup-standalone.py --revoke. Some firmware may still require the optional helper.

Enable the counter? The one-time diagnostic and Usage Access grants let it measure locally after reboot, without a computer or Shizuku. Readings stay hidden on Home or when unavailable. Stop pauses measurement. To revoke access, use the setup instructions.
